Optimize the supplied baseline on AMD EPYC 9654 with GCC 14.2. Use the actual AB-MCTS research trees and persistent Mother memory/integration policy.
Decode valid standard padded Base64 bytes from input1 (n bytes). Output starts with decoded byte count as uint64 at offset 0; bytes at offset 8..15 are reserved; decoded data begins at byte offset 16. Performance uses the upstream Lena image: n=141020 and 105764 decoded bytes. Check random valid data and other lengths. One core; output must be exact.
Edit only src/candidate.cpp. Keep extern C void run(const void*input1,const void*input2,void*output,int n,int parameter,int threads). Respect the threads argument as the CPU thread budget.
